reference_soap.assessment: Clinical presentation highly suggestive of Bacterial Conjunctivitis Pink Eye.
reference_soap.plan: Assess visual acuity and exclude corneal involvement. Provide hand hygiene and avoid sharing towels or eye cosmetics. Uncomplicated bacterial conjunctivitis may resolve without antibiotics; topical polymyxin B-trimethoprim is a reasonable treatment option when clinically indicated. Urgently assess for contact-lens-associated keratitis or other ocular disease if there is pain, photophobia, reduced vision, or corneal opacity.
